subject: Maintainer change for the fmi package

messages.author: ceb6545892b4dd19
messages.subject: Maintainer change for the fmi package
parts:
Hi everyone,

Unless someone objects or wants to volunteer, I'm assuming the maintainer role of the fmi package (client for the API of the Finnish Meteorological Institute). The original author (Jussi Jousimo) has moved on to other things and there a steady interest in using the package. While the package is operational, it could use some additional love. All contributions naturally welcome! 

Cheers,

Joona

messages.author: d6ff3e4ce292e4dd
messages.subject: Re: rOpenGov: Maintainer change for the fmi package
parts:
Absolutely !! I will try to see if I could also share some love with it on the way. Also interested in writing a story in R Journal perhaps.

Leo
